title: WATCH: Marcos plays tennis with Alex Eala
summary: President Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos Jr. on Tuesday picked up a tennis racket and led the ceremonial serve with the sport's rising star Alex Eala during her homecoming event in Pasig City.

blocks.text: President Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos Jr. on Tuesday picked up a tennis racket and led the ceremonial serve with the sport's rising star Alex Eala during her homecoming event in Pasig City.
Marcos and Eala gamely engaged in rallies that drew cheers from the audience at the Pasig Elementary School.
Up next was Education Secretary Sonny Angara, who had a longer rally against Eala.
The Filipino tennis sensation also conducted a tennis demonstration during the event, teaching young athletes the basics of tennis.
Olympic gold medal weightlifter Hidilyn Diaz and former world No. 2 pole vaulter EJ Obiena were also present during the activity.
During her homecoming, the Department of Education and Milo Philippines conferred the Gawad Sulo ng Simula at Tagumpay to Eala for her outstanding achievement.
Eala has climbed to a career-high ranking of No. 15 in the world, capping her 2026 season with a runner-up finish at the Hong Kong Tennis Open.
In his speech, Marcos praised Eala for serving as a reminder for her countrymen to be proud of being Filipinos.
"Pagka may kausap kaming hindi Pilipino, 'Ayan ang mga Pilipino. Akala ninyo kayo lang ang magaling? Magagaling din ang Pinoy,' and you make us proud to be Filipino," he added.
(When we talk to foreigners we say, 'Look at Filipinos. You thought you're the only ones who excel? Filipinos also excel,' and Alex you make us proud to be Filipino.)
